etymology: neuter of 4413 as adverb (with or without 3588)
avSummary: first 52, at the first + 3588 2, first of all 2, misc 5
definition:
1) first in time or place
    1a) in any succession of things or persons
 2) first in rank
    2a) influence, honour
    2b) chief
    2c) principal
 3) first, at the first
